processes.meter_flow_missing_deal_resolution: Logistics/scheduling staff find meter flow with no deal or an expired/mismatched deal ticket and ask the deal owner to extend, create, or identify the deal so the allocation can clear.
processes.deal_price_invoice_discrepancy: A price or charge on a deal or pipeline invoice differs from internal records or contract terms and must be investigated, disputed, or resolved with the counterparty.
processes.nomination_change_adjustment: Counterparty or pipeline changes, cuts, or errors in nominations require checking and revising the nomination or deal ticket volumes.
processes.meter_volume_allocation_variance: Allocation, imbalance, estimate, or unmetered-gas volume anomalies are flagged and must be reviewed, corrected, or closely watched.
processes.daily_nomination_actuals_distribution: Counterparties send daily nomination or actuals files to the desk for review and entry.
processes.periodic_financial_report_distribution: Accounting circulates monthly ledgers and O&M budget reports to desk managers.
processes.deal_pathing_and_counterparty_activation: Deals are pathed, counterparties/contracts activated, and deals actualized and balanced, with status chasing among ops staff.
